name: Iguaçu Falls
blurb: Iguaçu Falls spans the border of Argentina and Brazil as the largest waterfall system in the world, featuring roughly 275 cascades and the powerful Devil's Throat gorge. Online conversation is currently quiet, though showing strong growth compared to baseline activity.

positive: Described as an impressive and massive natural wonder
Highlights include viewing the falls from both the Brazilian and Argentinian sides
Opportunities to see birds and wildlife nearby
negative: Rising flight and trip prices noted by visitors
Water flow can be reduced during periods with less rain
Some travelers found certain aspects less impressive than expected
